summary: PickPath auto-picker prefers Fleet over Hermes for ClassOwnerAPI when Fleet can actually dispatch (token + key + binary); Hermes is fallback when Fleet incomplete or explicit --via=hermes.
reason: Fleet handles all signed commands reliably from anywhere. Auto-pick must check full dispatch readiness (not just token) so missing key/binary falls back to Hermes instead of hard-failing. Explicit --via=fleet always tries Fleet and lets dispatch surface specific errors.
validated_outcome: Token+key+binary -> Fleet; token-only+hermesRunning -> Hermes fallback; --via=fleet always tries Fleet
